changes: Project stats show cost in USD: for one project, for all projects together, and for each project in the projects table
Cost counts runs logged from this version on. Older runs and models without a price show as runs without a price
Project page shows stats: executions, success rate, average latency, tokens, prompts, traces, datasets, evaluations, and a 14-day executions chart
Projects page shows the same stats for all projects together, plus prompts, executions and success rate for each project in the table
Batch API: create a batch, add items, submit, read results page by page, cancel. OpenAI, Anthropic and Google run at the provider batch price
OpenRouter batches run through execute at full price only when you ask for fallback paced
Anthropic added as a fourth AI provider
API execute returns cost for OpenAI, Google and Anthropic prompts, computed from the LM SDK price table
Google prompts with Google search enabled now really send the search tool
Rename a prompt without a new version: PATCH /manage/projects/{project}/prompts/{prompt}
Evaluation page shows live activity: progress, each sent call, errors, and a warning when a run may be stuck
A failed evaluation is marked failed instead of staying running
OpenAI prompts with reasoning summary Enabled or Disabled no longer fail with 400 Invalid value
Evaluation calls now appear on the Logs page, including failed attempts
Add logs to a new dataset: choose New dataset in the Add to dataset dialog
API execute returns 504 with code provider_timeout when OpenRouter does not answer within 240 s, so clients can skip the retry
Durations show in readable units: 850ms, 8.5s, 4m 52s
OpenRouter prompts: set reasoning effort, provider order, temperature and max tokens
OpenRouter calls stop after 240 s and are not retried, so a slow call ends as a logged error
API execute returns usage with cost, the model, provider, version and log id
API execute can run a chosen prompt version
The local dev server shows a DEV logo and favicon
Click the version number to see this list of changes
OpenRouter added as a third AI provider
New models: GPT-6 and Gemini 3.x; retired Gemini models removed
Management API for AI agents
Package and Wrangler updates
